fn rr_enter(reader:*RmdReader)->bool {
    if (*reader).failed { return false; }
    if (*reader).depth>=256u32 {
        rr_error(reader,(*reader).token.offset,"parser nesting limit of 256 exceeded");return false;
    }
    (*reader).depth=(*reader).depth+1u32;return true;
}

fn rr_leave(reader:*RmdReader)->unit { (*reader).depth=(*reader).depth-1u32; }

fn rr_capacity(reader:*RmdReader,capacity:usize)->usize {
    if capacity>(~0usize)/2usize {
        rr_error(reader,(*reader).token.offset,"too many list entries");return 0usize;
    }
    if capacity==0usize { return 4usize; }
    return capacity*2usize;
}

fn rr_new_expr(reader:*RmdReader,kind:u32,offset:usize)->*RmdExpr {
    var result:*RmdExpr=rr_alloc(reader,sizeof(RmdExpr),alignof(RmdExpr)) as *RmdExpr;
    if result!=null(*RmdExpr) {
        (*result).kind=kind;(*result).loc=make RmdLoc {source:(*reader).source,offset:offset};
    }
    return result;
}

fn rr_new_stmt(reader:*RmdReader,kind:u32,offset:usize)->*RmdStmt {
    var result:*RmdStmt=rr_alloc(reader,sizeof(RmdStmt),alignof(RmdStmt)) as *RmdStmt;
    if result!=null(*RmdStmt) {
        (*result).kind=kind;(*result).loc=make RmdLoc {source:(*reader).source,offset:offset};
    }
    return result;
}

fn rr_new_type(reader:*RmdReader,kind:u32,offset:usize)->*RmdTypeSyntax {
    var result:*RmdTypeSyntax=rr_alloc(reader,sizeof(RmdTypeSyntax),alignof(RmdTypeSyntax)) as *RmdTypeSyntax;
    if result!=null(*RmdTypeSyntax) {
        (*result).kind=kind;(*result).loc=make RmdLoc {source:(*reader).source,offset:offset};
    }
    return result;
}

fn rr_new_decl(reader:*RmdReader,kind:u32,offset:usize)->*RmdDecl {
    var result:*RmdDecl=rr_alloc(reader,sizeof(RmdDecl),alignof(RmdDecl)) as *RmdDecl;
    if result!=null(*RmdDecl) {
        (*result).kind=kind;(*result).loc=make RmdLoc {source:(*reader).source,offset:offset};
    }
    return result;
}

fn rr_hook_checked(reader:*RmdReader,count:usize,offset:usize,cursor:usize,kind:u32,handled:bool,errors:usize)->bool {
    if (*(*reader).context).error_count!=errors { (*reader).failed=true;return false; }
    if (*reader).failed {
        rmd_set_error((*reader).context,(*reader).source,offset,"reader hook failed without a diagnostic");
        return false;
    }
    if handled {
        if (*reader).token_count<=count {
            rr_error(reader,offset,"reader hook returned syntax without consuming input");return false;
        }
    } else {
        if (*reader).token_count!=count || (*reader).token.offset!=offset || (*reader).offset!=cursor || (*reader).token.kind!=kind {
            rr_error(reader,offset,"unhandled reader hook consumed or changed its token");return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

// Parse one type with its hook. Use rr_standard_type to delegate this production.
fn rr_type(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdTypeSyntax {
    if !rr_enter(reader) { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
    var result:*RmdTypeSyntax=null(*RmdTypeSyntax);
    if (*reader).hooks!=null(*RmdReaderHooks) &&
       (*(*reader).hooks).type_syntax!=null(fn(*RmdReader,*u8)->*RmdTypeSyntax) {
        var count:usize=(*reader).token_count;
        var offset:usize=(*reader).token.offset;
        var cursor:usize=(*reader).offset;
        var kind:u32=(*reader).token.kind;
        var errors:usize=(*(*reader).context).error_count;
        result=(*(*reader).hooks).type_syntax(reader,(*(*reader).hooks).user);
        if !rr_hook_checked(reader,count,offset,cursor,kind,result!=null(*RmdTypeSyntax),errors) {
            rr_leave(reader);return null(*RmdTypeSyntax);
        }
    }
    if result==null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { result=rr_standard_type(reader); }
    rr_leave(reader);
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
    return result;
}

// Bypass only this type hook. Nested types still use rr_type.
fn rr_standard_type(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdTypeSyntax {
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
    var result:*RmdTypeSyntax=rr_new_type(reader,RMD_T_NAME,(*reader).token.offset);
    if result==null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { return result; }
    if (*reader).token.kind==RR_TYPE {
        (*result).kind=(*reader).token.integer_type;
        rr_next(reader);
    } else {
        if (*reader).token.kind==RR_NAME { (*result).name=rr_name(reader); }
        else {
            if rr_take(reader,42u32) {
                (*result).kind=RMD_T_POINTER;(*result).base=rr_type(reader);
            } else {
                if rr_take(reader,91u32) {
                    (*result).kind=RMD_T_ARRAY;(*result).base=rr_type(reader);
                    if !rr_expect(reader,59u32,"expected ';' in array type") { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
                    if (*reader).token.kind!=RR_COUNT {
                        rr_error(reader,(*reader).token.offset,"expected an unsuffixed decimal array count");return null(*RmdTypeSyntax);
                    }
                    (*result).count=(*reader).token.integer;
                    if !rr_next(reader) || !rr_expect(reader,93u32,"expected ']'") { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
                } else {
                    if rr_take(reader,RR_FN) {
                        (*result).kind=RMD_T_FUNCTION;
                        if !rr_expect(reader,40u32,"expected '('") { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
                        var capacity:usize=0usize;
                        while (*reader).token.kind!=41u32 && !(*reader).failed {
                            if (*result).param_count==capacity {
                                capacity=rr_capacity(reader,capacity);
                                if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
                                (*result).params=rmd_try_grow_array((*reader).context,(*result).params as *u8,
                                    (*result).param_count,capacity,sizeof(*RmdTypeSyntax),alignof(*RmdTypeSyntax)) as **RmdTypeSyntax;
                                if (*result).params==null(**RmdTypeSyntax) { rr_allocation_failed(reader);return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
                            }
                            var parameter:*RmdTypeSyntax=rr_type(reader);
                            if parameter==null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
                            (*result).params[(*result).param_count]=parameter;
                            (*result).param_count=(*result).param_count+1usize;
                            if !rr_take(reader,44u32) { break; }
                        }
                        if !rr_expect(reader,41u32,"expected ')'") || !rr_expect(reader,RR_ARROW,"expected '->'") {
                            return null(*RmdTypeSyntax);
                        }
                        (*result).base=rr_type(reader);
                    } else { rr_error(reader,(*reader).token.offset,"expected a type"); }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
    return result;
}

fn rr_arguments(reader:*RmdReader,expression:*RmdExpr,end:u32)->bool {
    var capacity:usize=0usize;
    while (*reader).token.kind!=end && !(*reader).failed {
        if (*expression).arg_count==capacity {
            capacity=rr_capacity(reader,capacity);
            if (*reader).failed { return false; }
            (*expression).args=rmd_try_grow_array((*reader).context,(*expression).args as *u8,
                (*expression).arg_count,capacity,sizeof(*RmdExpr),alignof(*RmdExpr)) as **RmdExpr;
            if (*expression).args==null(**RmdExpr) { rr_allocation_failed(reader);return false; }
        }
        var argument:*RmdExpr=rr_expression(reader);
        if argument==null(*RmdExpr) { return false; }
        (*expression).args[(*expression).arg_count]=argument;
        (*expression).arg_count=(*expression).arg_count+1usize;
        if !rr_take(reader,44u32) { break; }
    }
    if end==41u32 { return rr_expect(reader,end,"expected ')'"); }
    return rr_expect(reader,end,"expected '}'");
}

fn rr_constructor(reader:*RmdReader,offset:usize)->*RmdExpr {
    var result:*RmdExpr=null(*RmdExpr);
    if (*reader).token.kind==91u32 {
        result=rr_new_expr(reader,RMD_E_ARRAY,offset);
        if result==null(*RmdExpr) { return result; }
        (*result).syntax_type=rr_type(reader);
        if !rr_expect(reader,123u32,"expected '{'") || !rr_arguments(reader,result,125u32) { return null(*RmdExpr); }
    } else {
        if (*reader).token.kind!=RR_NAME {
            rr_error(reader,(*reader).token.offset,"expected a record name or an array type after 'make'");return null(*RmdExpr);
        }
        result=rr_new_expr(reader,RMD_E_RECORD,offset);
        if result==null(*RmdExpr) { return result; }
        (*result).syntax_type=rr_type(reader);
        var tail:**RmdInit=&(*result).inits;
        if !rr_expect(reader,123u32,"expected '{'") { return null(*RmdExpr); }
        while (*reader).token.kind!=125u32 && !(*reader).failed {
            var item:*RmdInit=rr_alloc(reader,sizeof(RmdInit),alignof(RmdInit)) as *RmdInit;
            if item==null(*RmdInit) { return null(*RmdExpr); }
            (*item).loc=make RmdLoc {source:(*reader).source,offset:(*reader).token.offset};
            (*item).name=rr_name(reader);
            if !rr_expect(reader,58u32,"expected ':'") { return null(*RmdExpr); }
            (*item).value=rr_expression(reader);
            if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdExpr); }
            *tail=item;tail=&(*item).next;
            if !rr_take(reader,44u32) { break; }
        }
        if !rr_expect(reader,125u32,"expected '}'") { return null(*RmdExpr); }
    }
    return result;
}

fn rr_primary(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdExpr {
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdExpr); }
    var token:RmdReaderToken=(*reader).token;
    var result:*RmdExpr=null(*RmdExpr);
    if token.kind==RR_NAME {
        result=rr_new_expr(reader,RMD_E_NAME,token.offset);
        if result==null(*RmdExpr) { return result; }
        (*result).name=token.name;rr_next(reader);
    } else {
        if token.kind==RR_INTEGER {
            result=rr_new_expr(reader,RMD_E_INTEGER,token.offset);
            if result==null(*RmdExpr) { return result; }
            (*result).integer=token.integer;(*result).literal_type=token.integer_type;rr_next(reader);
        } else {
            if token.kind==RR_TRUE || token.kind==RR_FALSE {
                result=rr_new_expr(reader,RMD_E_BOOL,token.offset);
                if result==null(*RmdExpr) { return result; }
                (*result).integer=(token.kind==RR_TRUE) as u64;rr_next(reader);
            } else {
                if token.kind==RR_STRING {
                    result=rr_new_expr(reader,RMD_E_STRING,token.offset);
                    if result==null(*RmdExpr) { return result; }
                    (*result).bytes=token.bytes;(*result).byte_count=token.byte_count;rr_next(reader);
                } else {
                    if token.kind==40u32 {
                        if !rr_next(reader) { return null(*RmdExpr); }
                        result=rr_new_expr(reader,RMD_E_GROUP,token.offset);
                        if result==null(*RmdExpr) { return result; }
                        (*result).left=rr_expression(reader);
                        if !rr_expect(reader,41u32,"expected ')'") { return null(*RmdExpr); }
                    } else {
                        if token.kind==RR_MAKE {
                            if !rr_next(reader) { return null(*RmdExpr); }
                            return rr_constructor(reader,token.offset);
                        }
                        if token.kind==RR_NULL || token.kind==RR_SIZEOF || token.kind==RR_ALIGNOF {
                            if !rr_next(reader) { return null(*RmdExpr); }
                            var kind:u32=RMD_E_NULL;
                            if token.kind==RR_SIZEOF { kind=RMD_E_SIZEOF; }
                            if token.kind==RR_ALIGNOF { kind=RMD_E_ALIGNOF; }
                            result=rr_new_expr(reader,kind,token.offset);
                            if result==null(*RmdExpr) || !rr_expect(reader,40u32,"expected '('") { return null(*RmdExpr); }
                            (*result).syntax_type=rr_type(reader);
                            if !rr_expect(reader,41u32,"expected ')'") { return null(*RmdExpr); }
                        } else {
                            if token.kind!=RR_OFFSETOF {
                                rr_error(reader,token.offset,"expected an expression");return null(*RmdExpr);
                            }
                            if !rr_next(reader) { return null(*RmdExpr); }
                            result=rr_new_expr(reader,RMD_E_OFFSETOF,token.offset);
                            if result==null(*RmdExpr) || !rr_expect(reader,40u32,"expected '('") { return null(*RmdExpr); }
                            (*result).syntax_type=rr_new_type(reader,RMD_T_NAME,(*reader).token.offset);
                            if (*result).syntax_type==null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { return null(*RmdExpr); }
                            (*(*result).syntax_type).name=rr_name(reader);
                            if !rr_expect(reader,44u32,"expected ','") { return null(*RmdExpr); }
                            (*result).field_name=rr_name(reader);
                            if !rr_expect(reader,41u32,"expected ')'") { return null(*RmdExpr); }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdExpr); }
    return result;
}

fn rr_postfix(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdExpr {
    var expression:*RmdExpr=rr_primary(reader);
    if expression==null(*RmdExpr) { return expression; }
    while !(*reader).failed {
        var offset:usize=(*reader).token.offset;
        var next:*RmdExpr=null(*RmdExpr);
        if rr_take(reader,40u32) {
            next=rr_new_expr(reader,RMD_E_CALL,offset);
            if next==null(*RmdExpr) { return next; }
            (*next).left=expression;
            if !rr_arguments(reader,next,41u32) { return null(*RmdExpr); }
        } else {
            if rr_take(reader,91u32) {
                next=rr_new_expr(reader,RMD_E_INDEX,offset);
                if next==null(*RmdExpr) { return next; }
                (*next).left=expression;(*next).right=rr_expression(reader);
                if !rr_expect(reader,93u32,"expected ']'") { return null(*RmdExpr); }
            } else {
                if rr_take(reader,46u32) {
                    next=rr_new_expr(reader,RMD_E_FIELD,offset);
                    if next==null(*RmdExpr) { return next; }
                    (*next).left=expression;(*next).field_name=rr_name(reader);
                } else {
                    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdExpr); }
                    return expression;
                }
            }
        }
        expression=next;
    }
    return null(*RmdExpr);
}

// Parse a complete unary operand, including its standard postfix operations.
fn rr_prefix(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdExpr {
    if !rr_enter(reader) { return null(*RmdExpr); }
    var result:*RmdExpr=null(*RmdExpr);
    if (*reader).hooks!=null(*RmdReaderHooks) &&
       (*(*reader).hooks).prefix!=null(fn(*RmdReader,*u8)->*RmdExpr) {
        var count:usize=(*reader).token_count;
        var offset:usize=(*reader).token.offset;
        var cursor:usize=(*reader).offset;
        var kind:u32=(*reader).token.kind;
        var errors:usize=(*(*reader).context).error_count;
        result=(*(*reader).hooks).prefix(reader,(*(*reader).hooks).user);
        if !rr_hook_checked(reader,count,offset,cursor,kind,result!=null(*RmdExpr),errors) {
            rr_leave(reader);return null(*RmdExpr);
        }
    }
    if result==null(*RmdExpr) { result=rr_standard_prefix(reader); }
    rr_leave(reader);
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdExpr); }
    return result;
}

fn rr_standard_prefix(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdExpr {
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdExpr); }
    var kind:u32=(*reader).token.kind;
    var operation:u32=RMD_OP_NEG;
    if kind==33u32 { operation=RMD_OP_NOT; }
    if kind==126u32 { operation=RMD_OP_BIT_NOT; }
    if kind==42u32 { operation=RMD_OP_DEREF; }
    if kind==38u32 { operation=RMD_OP_ADDRESS; }
    if kind!=45u32 && kind!=33u32 && kind!=126u32 && kind!=42u32 && kind!=38u32 { return rr_postfix(reader); }
    var offset:usize=(*reader).token.offset;
    if !rr_next(reader) { return null(*RmdExpr); }
    var result:*RmdExpr=rr_new_expr(reader,RMD_E_UNARY,offset);
    if result==null(*RmdExpr) { return result; }
    (*result).op=operation;(*result).left=rr_prefix(reader);
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdExpr); }
    return result;
}

fn rr_cast(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdExpr {
    var expression:*RmdExpr=rr_prefix(reader);
    if expression==null(*RmdExpr) { return expression; }
    while (*reader).token.kind==RR_AS && !(*reader).failed {
        var converted:*RmdExpr=rr_new_expr(reader,RMD_E_CAST,(*reader).token.offset);
        if converted==null(*RmdExpr) || !rr_next(reader) { return null(*RmdExpr); }
        (*converted).left=expression;(*converted).syntax_type=rr_type(reader);expression=converted;
    }
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdExpr); }
    return expression;
}

fn rr_operator(token:u32,operation:*u32)->u32 {
    if token==RR_OR { *operation=RMD_OP_OR;return 1u32; }
    if token==RR_AND { *operation=RMD_OP_AND;return 2u32; }
    if token==124u32 { *operation=RMD_OP_BIT_OR;return 3u32; }
    if token==94u32 { *operation=RMD_OP_BIT_XOR;return 4u32; }
    if token==38u32 { *operation=RMD_OP_BIT_AND;return 5u32; }
    if token==RR_EQ { *operation=RMD_OP_EQ;return 6u32; }
    if token==RR_NE { *operation=RMD_OP_NE;return 6u32; }
    if token==60u32 { *operation=RMD_OP_LT;return 7u32; }
    if token==RR_LE { *operation=RMD_OP_LE;return 7u32; }
    if token==62u32 { *operation=RMD_OP_GT;return 7u32; }
    if token==RR_GE { *operation=RMD_OP_GE;return 7u32; }
    if token==RR_SHL { *operation=RMD_OP_SHL;return 8u32; }
    if token==RR_SHR { *operation=RMD_OP_SHR;return 8u32; }
    if token==43u32 { *operation=RMD_OP_ADD;return 9u32; }
    if token==45u32 { *operation=RMD_OP_SUB;return 9u32; }
    if token==42u32 { *operation=RMD_OP_MUL;return 10u32; }
    if token==47u32 { *operation=RMD_OP_DIV;return 10u32; }
    if token==37u32 { *operation=RMD_OP_REM;return 10u32; }
    return 0u32;
}

fn rr_binary(reader:*RmdReader,minimum:u32)->*RmdExpr {
    var left:*RmdExpr=rr_cast(reader);
    if left==null(*RmdExpr) { return left; }
    var compared:bool=false;
    var equated:bool=false;
    while !(*reader).failed {
        var operation:u32=RMD_OP_ADD;
        var precedence:u32=rr_operator((*reader).token.kind,&operation);
        if precedence<minimum { return left; }
        if (precedence==7u32 && compared)||(precedence==6u32 && equated) {
            rr_error(reader,(*reader).token.offset,"comparisons cannot chain at the same precedence");return null(*RmdExpr);
        }
        if precedence==7u32 { compared=true; }
        if precedence==6u32 { equated=true; }
        var expression:*RmdExpr=rr_new_expr(reader,RMD_E_BINARY,(*reader).token.offset);
        if expression==null(*RmdExpr) || !rr_next(reader) { return null(*RmdExpr); }
        (*expression).op=operation;(*expression).left=left;
        (*expression).right=rr_binary(reader,precedence+1u32);
        left=expression;
    }
    return null(*RmdExpr);
}

fn rr_expression(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdExpr {
    if !rr_enter(reader) { return null(*RmdExpr); }
    var result:*RmdExpr=rr_binary(reader,1u32);
    rr_leave(reader);
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdExpr); }
    return result;
}

fn rr_simple_statement(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdStmt {
    var offset:usize=(*reader).token.offset;
    var result:*RmdStmt=null(*RmdStmt);
    if rr_take(reader,RR_VAR) {
        result=rr_new_stmt(reader,RMD_S_VAR,offset);
        if result==null(*RmdStmt) { return result; }
        (*result).name=rr_name(reader);
        if !rr_expect(reader,58u32,"expected ':'") { return null(*RmdStmt); }
        (*result).syntax_type=rr_type(reader);
        if !rr_expect(reader,61u32,"expected '='") { return null(*RmdStmt); }
        (*result).uninitialized=rr_take(reader,RR_UNINIT);
        if !(*result).uninitialized { (*result).value=rr_expression(reader); }
    } else {
        if rr_take(reader,RR_BREAK) { result=rr_new_stmt(reader,RMD_S_BREAK,offset); }
        else {
            if rr_take(reader,RR_CONTINUE) { result=rr_new_stmt(reader,RMD_S_CONTINUE,offset); }
            else {
                if rr_take(reader,RR_TRAP) { result=rr_new_stmt(reader,RMD_S_TRAP,offset); }
                else {
                    if rr_take(reader,RR_RETURN) {
                        result=rr_new_stmt(reader,RMD_S_RETURN,offset);
                        if result==null(*RmdStmt) { return result; }
                        if (*reader).token.kind!=59u32 { (*result).expr=rr_expression(reader); }
                    } else {
                        result=rr_new_stmt(reader,RMD_S_EXPR,offset);
                        if result==null(*RmdStmt) { return result; }
                        (*result).expr=rr_expression(reader);
                        if rr_take(reader,61u32) {
                            (*result).kind=RMD_S_ASSIGN;(*result).value=rr_expression(reader);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if result==null(*RmdStmt) || !rr_expect(reader,59u32,"expected ';'") { return null(*RmdStmt); }
    return result;
}

fn rr_statement(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdStmt {
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdStmt); }
    var result:*RmdStmt=null(*RmdStmt);
    if (*reader).hooks!=null(*RmdReaderHooks) &&
       (*(*reader).hooks).statement!=null(fn(*RmdReader,*u8)->*RmdStmt) {
        var count:usize=(*reader).token_count;
        var offset:usize=(*reader).token.offset;
        var cursor:usize=(*reader).offset;
        var kind:u32=(*reader).token.kind;
        var errors:usize=(*(*reader).context).error_count;
        if !rr_enter(reader) { return null(*RmdStmt); }
        result=(*(*reader).hooks).statement(reader,(*(*reader).hooks).user);
        rr_leave(reader);
        if !rr_hook_checked(reader,count,offset,cursor,kind,result!=null(*RmdStmt),errors) { return null(*RmdStmt); }
        if result!=null(*RmdStmt) && (*result).next!=null(*RmdStmt) {
            rr_error(reader,offset,"statement hook must return one unlinked statement");return null(*RmdStmt);
        }
    }
    if result==null(*RmdStmt) { result=rr_standard_statement(reader); }
    return result;
}

fn rr_standard_statement(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdStmt {
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdStmt); }
    if (*reader).token.kind==123u32 { return rr_block(reader); }
    var offset:usize=(*reader).token.offset;
    if rr_take(reader,RR_IF) {
        var result:*RmdStmt=rr_new_stmt(reader,RMD_S_IF,offset);
        if result==null(*RmdStmt) { return result; }
        (*result).expr=rr_expression(reader);(*result).body=rr_block(reader);
        if rr_take(reader,RR_ELSE) { (*result).otherwise=rr_block(reader); }
        if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdStmt); }
        return result;
    }
    if rr_take(reader,RR_WHILE) {
        var result:*RmdStmt=rr_new_stmt(reader,RMD_S_WHILE,offset);
        if result==null(*RmdStmt) { return result; }
        (*result).expr=rr_expression(reader);(*result).body=rr_block(reader);
        if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdStmt); }
        return result;
    }
    return rr_simple_statement(reader);
}

// Consume a standard braced block. Each contained statement can use its hook.
fn rr_block(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdStmt {
    if !rr_enter(reader) { return null(*RmdStmt); }
    var result:*RmdStmt=rr_new_stmt(reader,RMD_S_BLOCK,(*reader).token.offset);
    if result==null(*RmdStmt) || !rr_expect(reader,123u32,"expected '{'") {
        rr_leave(reader);return null(*RmdStmt);
    }
    var tail:**RmdStmt=&(*result).body;
    while (*reader).token.kind!=125u32 && !(*reader).failed {
        if (*reader).token.kind==RR_EOF {
            rr_error(reader,(*reader).token.offset,"expected '}' before end of input");break;
        }
        var statement:*RmdStmt=rr_statement(reader);
        if statement==null(*RmdStmt) { break; }
        *tail=statement;tail=&(*statement).next;
    }
    var complete:bool=rr_expect(reader,125u32,"expected '}'");
    rr_leave(reader);
    if !complete { return null(*RmdStmt); }
    return result;
}

// Consume RR_RECORD, its fields, and the closing brace. Nested types use hooks.
fn rr_record(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdDecl {
    var result:*RmdDecl=rr_new_decl(reader,RMD_D_RECORD,(*reader).token.offset);
    if result==null(*RmdDecl) || !rr_expect(reader,RR_RECORD,"expected 'record'") { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    (*result).name=rr_name(reader);
    if !rr_expect(reader,123u32,"expected '{'") { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    var tail:**RmdField=&(*result).fields;
    while !(*reader).failed {
        var field:*RmdField=rr_alloc(reader,sizeof(RmdField),alignof(RmdField)) as *RmdField;
        if field==null(*RmdField) { return null(*RmdDecl); }
        (*field).loc=make RmdLoc {source:(*reader).source,offset:(*reader).token.offset};
        (*field).name=rr_name(reader);
        if !rr_expect(reader,58u32,"expected ':'") { return null(*RmdDecl); }
        (*field).syntax_type=rr_type(reader);
        if !rr_expect(reader,59u32,"expected ';'") { return null(*RmdDecl); }
        (*field).index=(*result).field_count;
        (*result).field_count=(*result).field_count+1usize;
        *tail=field;tail=&(*field).next;
        if (*reader).token.kind==125u32 { break; }
    }
    if !rr_expect(reader,125u32,"expected '}'") { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    return result;
}

// Consume a complete ordinary or extern function, including its final delimiter.
fn rr_function(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdDecl {
    var kind:u32=RMD_D_FUNCTION;
    var token:u32=(*reader).token.kind;
    if token==RR_EXTERN { kind=RMD_D_EXTERN; }
    if token!=RR_FN && token!=RR_EXTERN {
        rr_error(reader,(*reader).token.offset,"expected a function declaration");return null(*RmdDecl);
    }
    var result:*RmdDecl=rr_new_decl(reader,kind,(*reader).token.offset);
    if result==null(*RmdDecl) || !rr_next(reader) { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    if kind==RMD_D_EXTERN && !rr_expect(reader,RR_FN,"expected 'fn'") { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    (*result).name=rr_name(reader);
    if !rr_expect(reader,40u32,"expected '('") { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    var tail:**RmdParam=&(*result).params;
    while (*reader).token.kind!=41u32 && !(*reader).failed {
        var parameter:*RmdParam=rr_alloc(reader,sizeof(RmdParam),alignof(RmdParam)) as *RmdParam;
        if parameter==null(*RmdParam) { return null(*RmdDecl); }
        (*parameter).loc=make RmdLoc {source:(*reader).source,offset:(*reader).token.offset};
        (*parameter).name=rr_name(reader);
        if !rr_expect(reader,58u32,"expected ':'") { return null(*RmdDecl); }
        (*parameter).syntax_type=rr_type(reader);
        if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdDecl); }
        *tail=parameter;tail=&(*parameter).next;
        (*result).param_count=(*result).param_count+1usize;
        if !rr_take(reader,44u32) { break; }
    }
    if !rr_expect(reader,41u32,"expected ')'") || !rr_expect(reader,RR_ARROW,"expected '->'") { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    (*result).syntax_type=rr_type(reader);
    if kind==RMD_D_FUNCTION { (*result).body=rr_block(reader); }
    else {
        if !rr_expect(reader,61u32,"expected '='") { return null(*RmdDecl); }
        if (*reader).token.kind!=RR_STRING {
            rr_error(reader,(*reader).token.offset,"expected a native symbol string");return null(*RmdDecl);
        }
        if (*reader).token.byte_count==1usize {
            rr_error(reader,(*reader).token.offset,"native symbol name must not be empty");return null(*RmdDecl);
        }
        var index:usize=0usize;
        while index+1usize<(*reader).token.byte_count {
            var byte:u8=(*reader).token.bytes[index];
            if byte==0u8 || byte>=128u8 {
                rr_error(reader,(*reader).token.offset,"native symbol name must be ASCII without zero bytes");return null(*RmdDecl);
            }
            index=index+1usize;
        }
        (*result).link_name=(*reader).token.bytes;
        if !rr_next(reader) || !rr_expect(reader,59u32,"expected ';'") { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    }
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    return result;
}

fn rr_standard_declaration(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdDecl {
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    if (*reader).token.kind==RR_RECORD { return rr_record(reader); }
    if (*reader).token.kind==RR_FN || (*reader).token.kind==RR_EXTERN { return rr_function(reader); }
    if (*reader).token.kind!=RR_CONST {
        rr_error(reader,(*reader).token.offset,"expected a declaration");return null(*RmdDecl);
    }
    var result:*RmdDecl=rr_new_decl(reader,RMD_D_CONST,(*reader).token.offset);
    if result==null(*RmdDecl) || !rr_next(reader) { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    (*result).name=rr_name(reader);
    if !rr_expect(reader,58u32,"expected ':'") { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    (*result).syntax_type=rr_type(reader);
    if !rr_expect(reader,61u32,"expected '='") { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    (*result).init=rr_expression(reader);
    if !rr_expect(reader,59u32,"expected ';'") { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    return result;
}

fn rr_declaration(reader:*RmdReader)->*RmdDecl {
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdDecl); }
    var result:*RmdDecl=null(*RmdDecl);
    if (*reader).hooks!=null(*RmdReaderHooks) &&
       (*(*reader).hooks).declaration!=null(fn(*RmdReader,*u8)->*RmdDecl) {
        var count:usize=(*reader).token_count;
        var offset:usize=(*reader).token.offset;
        var cursor:usize=(*reader).offset;
        var kind:u32=(*reader).token.kind;
        var errors:usize=(*(*reader).context).error_count;
        if !rr_enter(reader) { return null(*RmdDecl); }
        result=(*(*reader).hooks).declaration(reader,(*(*reader).hooks).user);
        rr_leave(reader);
        if !rr_hook_checked(reader,count,offset,cursor,kind,result!=null(*RmdDecl),errors) { return null(*RmdDecl); }
        if result!=null(*RmdDecl) && (*result).next!=null(*RmdDecl) {
            rr_error(reader,offset,"declaration hook must return one unlinked declaration");return null(*RmdDecl);
        }
    }
    if result==null(*RmdDecl) { result=rr_standard_declaration(reader); }
    return result;
}

// Read a complete declaration unit. Publish it in context only after success.
// The source and its descriptor remain live until context destruction.
fn rr_read(context:*RmdContext,source:*RmdSource,begin:usize,end:usize,hooks:*RmdReaderHooks)->*RmdUnit {
    var reader:RmdReader=uninit;
    if !rr_init(&reader,context,source,begin,end,hooks) { return null(*RmdUnit); }
    var parsed:*RmdUnit=rr_alloc(&reader,sizeof(RmdUnit),alignof(RmdUnit)) as *RmdUnit;
    if parsed==null(*RmdUnit) { return parsed; }
    (*parsed).source=source;
    var tail:**RmdDecl=&(*parsed).declarations;
    var ordinal:u64=0u64;
    while reader.token.kind!=RR_EOF && !reader.failed {
        var declaration:*RmdDecl=rr_declaration(&reader);
        if declaration==null(*RmdDecl) { return null(*RmdUnit); }
        if ordinal==~0u64 {
            rr_error(&reader,(*declaration).loc.offset,"too many declarations");return null(*RmdUnit);
        }
        ordinal=ordinal+1u64;
        (*declaration).unit_identity=(*source).identity;(*declaration).identity=ordinal;
        *tail=declaration;tail=&(*declaration).next;
    }
    if reader.failed { return null(*RmdUnit); }
    if (*context).last_unit==null(*RmdUnit) { (*context).units=parsed; }
    else { (*(*context).last_unit).next=parsed; }
    (*context).last_unit=parsed;
    return parsed;
}
